'''Ghorrock Teleport''' requires a [[Magic]] level of 96 to cast. It [[teleport]]s the caster to the [[Frozen Waste Plateau]] in the [[Wilderness]] (near the level 44 [[Wilderness Obelisk|obelisk]]), which was historically a part of the larger [[Ghorrock]] settlement. It has the highest Magic level requirement of any teleport.

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.

Casting this spell is a requirement for the [[Elite Wilderness Diary]]. The spell cannot be cast from within the [[Castle Wars]] mini game, nor can it be cast from the NMZ or Nightmare Zone. 

This spell and [[Spellbook Swap]] are tied for the highest Magic level requirement of all spells.
